spans.s: Traipiṭaka, cf. Trepiṭaka (EI 9), one versed in the three piṭakas, i. e. the three classes of Buddhist religious literature.
Traipiṭak-opādhyāya (LL), Buddhist; teacher of the three piṭakas.
, pp. 34-35), same as the composite god Tripuruṣa.
trairājya (EI 19), a group of three realms.
trairājya-sthiti (EI 27), cf. trairājya-sthitim = ātmasāt = kṛtavataḥ, ‘of one who has obtained steadiness in the three realms.’

Traividya (LL), Buddhist; teacher of the three piṭakas.
 (EI 16), cf. Trivedin.
Traividya-sāmānya (EI 23), same as Trivedin; cf. Cāturvidya-sāmānya = Caturvedin.
